generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD (2% or 2.5% of the estimated cost) into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time limit for bid submission.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time limit for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The cost of the Tender processing fee shall not be refundable.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender and the department will in no case be responsible and liable for those cost
Contractors should be registered as Forest Contractor in any division of Forest department for the financial year 2026-27.

All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Deputy Conservator of Forests, Ramanagara Division, Bangalure South, Ramanagara, reserves the right to verify the documents before approval.

The Principal Chief Conservator of Forests, (Wildlife), Bangalore / Conservator of Forests, (Territorial) Circle, Bangalore, and the Deputy Conservator of Forests, Ramanagara Division, Ramanagara, reserves the rights to reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.

The successful Tenderer shall deliver to the department a Security deposit in the forms of Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR) for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders (i.e. If any tenderer quotes rate below 15% (-15%) of working rate and if that rate is lowest, then the Tenderer will be called upon to pay the difference of the rate quoted by him below the 15%) in accordance with the Conditions of Contract in the Name of Deputy Conservator Of Forests, Ramanagara Division, Ramanagara in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR) before executing the agreement.
The work will be supervised by Range Forests Officers or any other staff authorised by him and the tenderes shall adhere to the instructions.

Payment for the completed works will be made only after the completion of the unit of work tendered to the contractor and duly check measured by the jurisdictional Assistant Conservator of Forests and jurisdictional Range Forest Officers.

If any tenderer quotes a rate that is more than 15% below the prevailing rate, and if that rate happens to be the lowest, then the difference up to the 15% margin must be paid as an additional security deposit.
Applicable taxes will be deducted at source as per prevailing Govt. orders.

In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement/commencement of the work, his legal heir, if he/she is an eligible registered contractor and is willing to take up the work, can execute and complete the work at the approved tender rates and conditions irrespective of the cost of the work.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.
All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to any public/private properties.
Contractor should take all precautionary measures to avoid any damage to the utilities during excavation as well as utility shifting. To that extent the contractor should indemnify the client.
Payment will be made subjected to availability of funds by DC bills only through Khajane-2.

The Contractor shall strictly follow the prevailing Contract Labour Act, The Payment of Wages Act, The Workmens Compensation Act, The Minimum Wages Act and all such Acts and rules are applicable to the execution of Contract.

Further particulars/details, if any, required by the Contractor can be obtained from the office of the Assistant Conservator of Forests, Wildlife Sub Division, Kanakapura, during the office hours on all working days.

The Earnest Money Deposit (E.M.D.) of all other tenderers (except the lowest and the lowest but one) will be refunded through e-portal. The E.M.D. of the lowest (L1) and the lowest but one (L2) will be refunded after the tenders are finally disposed of, provided that the successful tenderers Security Deposited will be refunded only after the completion report received from jurisdictional Assistant Conservator of Forests, and jurisdictional Range Forest Officers. The E.M.D. will not bear any interest.
As the area working is forest area, the working hours shall be between 9:00 am to 5:30 pm.
The Department shall not be responsible for any damages / loss caused by Wild animals to person or property of the contractor.

In the event of any difference of opinion regarding any of the clauses of the contract or the quantity/quality of work the decision of the Conservator of Forests, Bangalore (Territorial) Circle, Bangalore shall be final and binding on all parties.
All disputes arising out of the contract if taken to court shall be within the jurisdiction of Benagaluru South district.

All work tendered shall be completed within the prescribed time in the financial year 2026-27. In the exceptional case of work being continued to the next financial year, no enhancement of rate will be permitted.
In case if the contractor could not complete the work within prescribed time limit he/she would be liable for paying penalty decided by DCF, Ramanagara Division, Ramanagara.

In the event of the contractor abandoning the work in between and not continuing it, in spite of at least two notices issued/served to him/her, work will be entrusted to any other contractor at the risk and cost of the contractor abandoning the work, and all loss or damage incurred in the process be recoverable from him/her as if it were an arrear of land revenue.
The tenderer shall abide by all rules and regulations of Karnataka Forest Department.
Deputy Conservator of Forests / Conservator of Forests / Principal Conservator of Forest (Wildlife) reserves the rights to change or alter the terms and conditions of the tender at any point of time.
The Deputy Conservator of Forests reserves the right to impose any other conditions.
The competent authority reserves the right to make any changes or modifications to the above-mentioned works.
If the tender is cancelled, the tender application fee will not be refunded and cannot be used for any other work.

Contractors intending to participate in the e-tender shall, in advance, inspect the designated site for undertaking the Solar Tentacle Fence work during the year 2026-27 along with the concerned Range Forest Officers and obtain complete details of the site before participating in the tender process.
The EMD (Earnest Money Deposit) submitted through the e-portal will be retained for a period of 90 days from the date of opening of the tender.
This tender has been invited as per KW-1 or KW-2.

Human-wildlife conflict has become severe, and currently, wild elephants are raiding the farmlands of farmers in Bengaluru South district, causing damage to crops grown by farmers and loss of property. To prevent these wild elephant attacks, an Annual Action Plan has been submitted to the Conservator of Forests as per the funds allocated under the Honourable Chief Ministers Special Grant to undertake solar fencing construction works. Tenders have been invited for the works that have been granted administrative approval in anticipation of receiving approval.

technicalCriterionList.description: ITT 3.2 - To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last three years i.e. 2023-24 to 2025-26) (b) Satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one similar work / construction and erection of Tentacle solar power fence work of value not less than (usually not less than 50% work estimate) i) Mandating satisfactory completion as a prime contractor for at least one similar work to an extent of 50% of the cost of the work, for all works

ITT 3.2 (d) Tenderer shall obtain test reports for goods especially 24V energizer, Solar Module, Module Stand, System Mounting Stand, 100AH Solar Gel Solectron Battery, Lighting Diverter, Earthing System, Warning Signs, 15KV double insulated Lead Out Cable, Tool Kit, Raised Post 14 Feet, Elephant Post Guard 8 Feet, Stainless Steel Wire 1.5mm, S.S. Rope 1.5 MM, High Tensile Wire 2.59 mm, Bullets etc., from competent authority as per the existing IS standards. The same shall be attached in the technical bid.

Availability by owning at least 50% of the required / specified key & initial equipment for this work and the remaining 50% can be deployed on lease / hire basis for all works provided, the relevant documents for availability of this works are furnished.

Tender Capacity (Qualification of the Tenderer) 1.3 Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under Assessed available tender capacity
